description:
Split from fz-go4.18.3.2.3 (which greened the resume-CONSUMPTION half: #1,#2,adapts_delivered,carries_published via a static body consumption signal). REMAINING demand-layer cluster: #3 compiler2_native_program_resource_fixture_shapes_callable_boundaries_explicitly + #4 escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation_at_the_grounded_boundary_surface (full-run-only, schedule-dependent, entangled with #3).

ROOT CAUSE (re-derived at HEAD 64fdd0a6/d8e3bf47f; the ticket-stated boundary-path diagnosis is STALE -- code moved 931->933 tests). main calls the make_resource/2 LIBRARY WRAPPER (FunctionId 22), which tail-forwards (dest=Return) to the fz_make_resource/2 EXTERN (FunctionId 39). main DISCARDS the wrapper result. Proven by instrumentation: the spurious Whole reaching fz_make_resource enters via the CALL path (wrapper records non-ignore for fz_make_resource), NOT callable_boundary_return_demand_contributions. Source = the product self-seed in produce_runtime_demand_product (runtime_demand.rs:279): when session.return_demand(exec) is None it defaults to runtime_demand_for_executable_need(need) = Whole-by-need. The wrapper is unrecorded (main observes it with is_ignore, which call_return_demand_contributions/record_return_demand DROP), so it self-seeds Whole and forwards Whole to fz_make_resource; fz_make_resource (also unrecorded) likewise self-seeds Whole -> its ExecutableReturn anchors a non-empty resource return (keystone transport.rs:1845) -> return_reprs non-empty. #3 asserts it must be empty.

WHY A SEED TWEAK DOES NOT WORK (proven: seeding session-or-world default-ignore instead of Whole-by-need REGRESSED 10 tests, stable across 3 runs: cont_threaded_recursion, jit_keeps_tail_recursion_bounded, {jit_runs,routes}_nontail_if_join, interp_runs_enum_with_index, ...). The Whole-by-need self-seed is LOAD-BEARING: continuation/recursive executables are consumed via DELIVERY (record_delivered_call_return_demands) and, like the discarded wrapper, carry NO recorded return demand at product-seed time; their own ExecutableReturn relies on the fiction-Whole seed to not collapse to Nothing. A directly-discarded callee and a delivery-consumed continuation are INDISTINGUISHABLE under the current monotone-upward return-demand product -- both are "unrecorded". This is the "unknown is not none" memory note: the product conflates UNOBSERVED with OBSERVED-AND-DISCARDED. Recording observed-ignore distinctly still BAKES, because record_return_demand only joins UP -- an early unobserved fiction-Whole recorded for fz_make_resource cannot retract once a later observed-ignore arrives.

FIX DIRECTION (correct-by-construction, demand layer): make return demand a proper fixpoint whose seed is LOW (ignore) and which re-pulls to convergence, OR track observation as a distinct cell from demand so "all callers discard" is representable without the Whole fiction (and ensure no transient over-demand bakes into a non-invalidated product). High blast radius across record_return_demand / produce_runtime_demand_product / seed_root + the pull invalidation graph -> its own ticket, PROVEN monotone & schedule-independent (3 fresh full runs), no test weakening.
title: Typed-boundary return-demand over-report: discarded forwarding/extern callee transports its return (#3/#4)
